member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown.SanitizeLanguage(System.String)
member.summary: Validates the info string of a fenced code block. The value comes from the document and is copied onto the opening fence, so one containing a line break or a fence character would end the code block early and let the rest of the attribute be interpreted as Markdown. Letters and digits are accepted, including non-ASCII ones, and anything outside the accepted set drops the info string.
